projects.name: Skycast
projects.tagline: A clearer view of the weather.
projects.description: A live weather dashboard that combines current conditions, hourly forecasts, seven-day outlooks, and saved locations in one responsive experience.
projects.overview: Skycast makes everyday weather information easier to explore through a clean, data-focused interface. Powered by the Open-Meteo weather service, it presents current conditions and detailed forecasts alongside city search, browser-based location detection, and a dedicated saved-locations section. Users can switch between Celsius and Fahrenheit, adjust their default location, and manage weather preferences that are stored locally in their browser.
features: Live weather conditions and detailed weather metrics
Hourly forecasts and seven-day weather outlooks
City search and browser-based location detection
Saved locations for quick access to weather in different places
Celsius/Fahrenheit conversion and locally stored preferences
Dedicated forecast, locations, settings, and about pages

projects.name: NEXORA
projects.description: A premium multi-page technology storefront featuring product discovery, category browsing, search, filtering, product details, a shopping cart, and a wishlist.
projects.overview: NEXORA is an e-commerce website concept built around the idea that shopping for technology should feel focused, intuitive, and enjoyable. Its product catalogue spans categories such as audio, wearables, workspace accessories, and lifestyle technology. Visitors can explore curated collections, search and filter products, sort the shop catalogue, open individual product pages, add items to their cart, adjust quantities, and save products to a wishlist. Cart and wishlist data persist in the browser, making the shopping experience more consistent across visits. Supporting pages introduce the brand and provide a contact interface.
features: Multi-page storefront with home, shop, product, about, and contact pages
Technology product catalogue with category-based discovery
Product search, filtering, and sorting interactions
Individual product details and related-product recommendations
Shopping cart with quantity controls and an order summary
Persistent wishlist and saved cart contents
Responsive product cards, navigation, and shopping interface

projects.name: Apex Motors
projects.description: A premium automotive brand concept showcasing four fictional vehicle models through dedicated pages, design-led storytelling, and an engineering-focused experience.
projects.overview: Apex Motors explores how a distinctive automotive brand can communicate performance, design, and identity through a carefully structured website. Its lineup features four conceptual vehicles: APEX ONE, APEX GT, APEX RS, and APEX E, each with its own dedicated model page and design narrative. Visitors can explore the brand's story, discover its engineering principles, learn about the ownership experience, and browse the complete lineup. Strong typography, automotive imagery, and a deliberate visual hierarchy help create a cohesive digital showroom. The vehicles and brand are presented as a concept rather than a real-world commercial lineup.
features: Premium automotive-inspired design and visual storytelling
Four conceptual vehicles with dedicated model pages
Vehicle lineup and model discovery experience
Separate engineering, brand story, and experience sections
Automotive imagery, purposeful layouts, and strong typography
Contact page and responsive navigation

projects.name: Saffron & Ember
projects.description: A premium restaurant website concept combining an illustrated brand story, curated menu, food gallery, contact information, and a reservation enquiry experience.
projects.overview: Saffron & Ember presents a modern dining brand through warm visual storytelling, food photography, and hospitality-focused content. Visitors can explore signature dishes, browse a dedicated menu featuring starters, mains, desserts, and drinks, and discover the restaurant's philosophy through its story page. A separate gallery highlights the dining experience, while the contact and reservation enquiry pages provide ways to express interest and find relevant restaurant information. The website is designed to communicate atmosphere and character while keeping its main sections easy to navigate. Its reservation and contact interfaces are demonstration experiences, not a live booking or messaging service.
features: Multi-page restaurant website with a cohesive visual identity
Dedicated menu with food and drink categories
Signature dishes and food-focused imagery
Gallery showcasing the restaurant's atmosphere and cuisine
Restaurant story and hospitality-focused content
Contact page with location information and illustrative opening hours
Reservation enquiry form presented as a demonstration interface

projects.name: Cookify: Smart Recipe Finder
projects.tagline: Find a recipe for what you have.
projects.description: A Flutter recipe-discovery app that helps users find meals from available ingredients, search a recipe collection, save favourites, and follow step-by-step cooking instructions.
projects.overview: Cookify is a mobile recipe companion designed to make choosing what to cook more practical. Users can select ingredients they already have and explore matching recipes, with options to refine results by ingredient match, dietary type, preparation time, cuisine, and sorting preference. A dedicated search experience supports searching by recipe name or ingredients, with voice input and recent search history. The app also includes a browsable recipe library, saved favourites, recipe detail views, and a step-by-step cooking guide. Its recipe catalogue is retrieved from Firebase Cloud Firestore, while preferences, theme selection, favourites, and search history use local device storage. The application also integrates Google AdMob for advertising.
features: Ingredient-based recipe discovery
Recipe-name and ingredient search modes
Voice-assisted search and recent search history
Filters for ingredient matching, dietary type, and cooking time
Cuisine selection and recipe sorting options
Recipe library with detailed ingredients and cooking instructions
Favourites with filtering and sorting controls
Step-by-step cooking guide with previous and next navigation
Light and dark themes with saved preferences
Cloud-hosted recipe catalogue using Firebase Cloud Firestore
Local persistence for favourites, search history, and preferences
